main_text.p:
Bragada Mammarica lentus fulcator arena.
Burdegalam tamen ille tuam, tua tecta Garumna
Ingens hospes init, tibi maiestate remissa
Imperij decresct apex, tectoque minori
Cæsareus succedit honos, priuata subire
Culmina dignantur Latij diademata regni.
Sic Hecale Aegiden, sic te Tyrinthia proles
Ceperunt rigidi mapalia nuda Molorchi:
Sic posita quondam sceptri grauitate perustos
Iuppiter Aethiopas, candamque renisere Teihyn
Gaudet, & alternis interserit otia curis.
Ergo hospes positisque mimis, ventisque Garumna
Compositus, Borea non obluctante vel Austro,
Tranquillus, mitisque adsis, vulúque sereno
Crispentur tremula Zephyris felicibus vndæ.
Depositum tibi grande orbis, tibi publica vota,
Spemque suam credit, rectorem gentis libera,
Ausonia dominum, Borea pugnacis alumnum,
Vltorem Libyca terra, Scythiasque timorem,
Quem colit occasus, Boreas amat, vltimus horret
Ortus, & insidiemur folertia Mauri.
Cernis ut effractis populariā flumina clausteris
Accurrunt, properéque, tuis se iungere Nympha
Fluctibus, Oceanus refluus ut plenior vndis
Mísores conuoluat aquas, cupidaque videndi
Nereides, Nereúsque pater, Triónque canorus,
Et senior Glaucus, viridisque examina Phorci
Discurrent tremula per stagna liquentia cauda?
Tu quoque magnanimum quanuis stirps Carole avorum,
Magnanimus sis maior auis, te Gallia quanuis
Obuia sollicitet, quanuis cunabula pandat
Rhenum, & Austriaci renocem molimina sceptri,

page.notes: Printed text is in a Latin verse layout with long lines; the lower-right "Burdegala" is a line-end word, possibly a catchword. Several words are uncertain in the scan (e.g., "Mammarica", "Mísores", "Triónque") and marked as read from the scan only; no marginal notes are present.
